archetype: Eminence go-wide Vampire tokens with each-opponent damage converters and death drains; the aggro frame agrees (29 creatures in 26-32, 37 land copies, modal MV 3), and the two drain infinites are declared bonus lines, not the plan. NOTE: the 99 is frozen for a piloting-practice period — cut/add candidates below are a watch list for a future unlock, not a work order.
verdict: The LOCK bought what it paid for: the token-to-damage kill assembles in 57.4% of games (74.4% tutor-assisted), every engine component except the two declared one-card bonus lines sits between 52.9% and 78.9%, and the deck keeps 80.8% of opening sevens with a 91.9% turn-3 land drop. What binds is black mana: 27 B sources against a Karsten target of 36, 76.4% on-curve castability with rocks against the 90% standard — and black is where the drain payoffs live. The only other measured weakness is interaction breadth: zero answers to a graveyard, confirmed by oracle read. Everything else is at or above target once the taxonomy's floors are read against the cards.

axes.reading: 91.9% turn-3 land drop and 80.8% keepable sevens; the mana functions, so the pilot can mulligan toward spells, not lands.

axes.reading: B 27/36, R 17/22, W 21/22; on-curve B castability is 76.4% with rocks (mana_analysis) against Karsten's 90%, and B carries 39 pips across 29 cards versus R's 11 — the drain payoffs are the black cards, so the shortage taxes the kill, not the filler. The 36 target is priced from the deck's double-black QUORUM: mana_analysis records effective_pips 2 for black beside max_pips 3, and the Karsten count for a double pip at the turn-3 horizon is 36 — no single cut re-prices it, because the quorum (Captivating Vampire, Sanctum Seeker, Champion of Dusk, Bloodline Keeper, Sanguine Bond, Bloodthirsty Conqueror and peers) stays double-black.

cut_candidates.why: A pain land that produces no black in the deck's 9-short colour; the natural slot for a typal land that does.
cut_candidates.cost_of_cutting: An untapped R/W source in a deck also 5 short on red — so the incoming land must produce red too (Path of Ancestry qualifies; Voldaren Estate does not on the restriction-aware count), or the swap moves the shortage rather than closing it.

cut_candidates.why: In no goldfish group — the LOCK's own cut criterion — and a holdover from the initial build (in the deck since 2026-07-28, per deck-history): its deterrent-blocker job is the least load-bearing seat among the eleven cheap Vampires now that the LOCK's five adds (Indulgent Aristocrat, Vampire Cutthroat, Voldaren Epicure, Blood Artist, Cruel Celebrant) carry the density.
cut_candidates.cost_of_cutting: One of the eleven MV-2-or-less Vampires the LOCK's density metric counts (7 -> 11), so cutting it gives back a slice of the measured eminence fuel; it is also the deck's only deathtouch+lifelink creature (keyword scan), so the deterrent-blocker job goes unfilled.

cut_candidates.why: A 5.2%-assembled one-card bonus line with zero closers — the audit's combo and role routes both return empty — whose {1}{B}{B}{B}, the only triple-B cost in the 99, is the single hardest cast in the deck's shortest colour: the card the 9-source black shortage taxes hardest. Cutting it would not move the colour-sources target (the double-black quorum prices that); the argument is the slot, not the mana base.
cut_candidates.cost_of_cutting: Orphans the verified lethal math of stacks 003 and 007; the deck loses its drain doubler, which is the difference between a Sanctum Seeker attack that hurts and one that kills, and the pilot demonstrably loves these lines. Recommending it anyway is what makes this a watch-list entry and not a work order.

add_candidates.why: Paired with the Battlefield Forge cut it is +1 black with red and white unchanged — the only clean B gain that costs no other colour — plus a scry on every Vampire cast in a 29-creature typal deck. Taplands go 3→4, well under the cap of 8. Sized honestly: this closes 1 of the 9-source black gap; it is the best single land swap, not a fix. The recon-favoured alternative, Voldaren Estate (65.1%), was checked and rejected: manabase.land_colors credits its Vampire-restricted coloured mode zero colours, so the measured axis would not move — the Bojuka Bog trap.

evidence.recon_support: Typal mana is the single largest package this deck runs none of — Path of Ancestry 61.3% of Tokens-tagged Edgar lists (as_of 2026-08-03; the finding's Command Tower/Cavern of Souls halves are already applied)

add_candidates.closes: THE SURVIVING INFINITE (stacks 004 and 006): Bloodthirsty Conqueror + a lifegain-loss half
add_candidates.why: The audit's closer search ranks it first (popularity 128,280). With it in the 99 the infinite plan runs through four pairings — EB+Sanguine Bond, EB+Vito, Conqueror+Vito, Conqueror+Sanguine Bond — so the infinite plan no longer rests on one 7.1% card, and stacks 001 and 005 already carry checker-passed resolutions of the EB loops (non-presentable today only because the card left on 2026-08-04). It is death-drain with zero graveyard content, so it is direction-compatible under the new in-plan ruling; the physical copy is allocated to yawgmoth-swarm, which makes this a cross-deck decision (see open_questions).

findings.note: FINAL (round 3). The round-2 miscount is fixed: the quorum parenthetical now reads Captivating Vampire ({1}{B}{B}, verified on my own B-pip enumeration of cards.json) in place of Vito; all six named members now carry >=2 B pips. The mechanism was verified by re-derivation in round 2 and is unchanged: mana_analysis records pips.B.effective_pips 2 beside max_pips 3, sources_needed(2, turn 3) = 36 reproduces the target, and effective_pips stays 2 with each of the 29 B cards removed in turn, so 'no single cut re-prices it' is true. Confirmed the edit is single-occurrence: the three remaining Vito mentions (engine SPOF[0] pairing, add_candidates[1] pairings and stack-001 evidence) are correct uses and verbatim from round 2.

All 16 measured values equal a fresh deck-audit run (consistency 0.919, colour-sources -9, breadth 4, interaction 14, card-advantage 4, ramp 7, mana-base 37, mana-sources 42, taplands 3, threat-density 13, creatures 29, protection 7, sweepers 1, curve 3, power 4, tutors 3). 14 = 5 removal:damage each-opponent payoffs + Boros Charm + 8 enumerated true answers; role scan reproduces it (15 removal:* copies minus Olivia's Wrath on the sweeper axis); Elspeth, Storm Slayer's -3 is real removal.
Oracle scan of all 97 entries, both faces: Takenuma, Abandoned Mire is the only graveyard-touching text and targets your own yard. Zero-answers claim holds past the heuristic's floor.

Probe list matches the audit note verbatim; the 7-card draw-engine component assembles at 0.734; the ratios quote is used as a floor consistent with the section's 'counts of functions ... too one size fits all' caveats.

All six component sizes and rates match the audit (7/0.735, 8/0.789, 8/0.789, 7/0.734, 6/0.68, 5/0.609). Both SPOFs are the deck's two DECLARED one-card bonus lines, priced with the verbatim 7.1% citation and framed as ceilings, not defects. SPOF[0] closer claim matches the audit (Exquisite Blood first, popularity 128,280); SPOF[1] zero-closer claim matches (both routes empty), and its rewritten 'why' contains only verified claims (only triple-B in the 99, black the largest deficit at -9, sub-Karsten castability). Battlefield Forge appears in no stack scenario and no goldfish group; produces R/W only per mana_analysis; cost_of_cutting is a real constraint (deck also R -5, W -1) and conditions the incoming land on red.

The '7 -> 11' figure verified against the git diff itself: the LOCK added 5 of the current 11 MV<=2 Vampires and cut exactly one (Cemetery Gatekeeper {1}{R} MV 2; Forerunner of the Legion is {2}{W} MV 3 and does not count), so 11 - 5 + 1 = 7. Only-deathtouch+lifelink-creature claim confirmed by keyword scan. In no goldfish group, in no stack scenario.

Rests only on verified facts: 5.2% assembled, zero closers, only triple-B cost, hardest cast in the most-deficient colour - and explicitly states the cut would NOT move the colour-sources target. orphans_stack [003,007] confirmed: both checker-passed with Bloodletter in the scenario block; cost_of_cutting prices the orphaning; 'painful' present, so the cut list did not dodge the job.

Recon figures verbatim (Path of Ancestry 61.3%, Voldaren Estate 65.1%, as_of 2026-08-03, dated in place). Re-ran manabase.land_colors on Voldaren Estate: returns empty set, so the restriction-aware rejection is true. Swap arithmetic vs Battlefield Forge: +1 B, R/W unchanged, taplands 3->4 under the cap; honestly sized as 1 of the 9-source gap.
